plate_comment: Start-up initialization of cm848_calculateFuelPressureSetpoint: sets fuel_pressure_setpoint_transition_state and fuel_pressure_setpoint_winning_term_code to 1 and the 16 lookup interpolation state words 0x3fd0ca-0x3fd0e8 (first argument of its table lookups) to 2. Called once from cm848_applicationMain. (was hpcr_register_state_save)
evidence: Body only stores 1 / 1 / 2 x 16 to variables whose only users are the setpoint calculator and this function (xref: 0 reads, 1 write each).

plate_comment: Third rail pressure governor monitor, switched off in this calibration (byte 0x409aa0 = 0): when the engine speed is within 160 counts (20 rpm) of governor_speed_limit_output with the vehicle stopped, cold_start_phase at the governor setpoint, coolant 180-205 F and no injector, rail pressure or related fault, it debounces (80 net passes) fuel_pressure_governor_demand above 283 and sets fault 57 (P1221), clearing it when the count returns to 0. (was engine_camTiming_speedWindow_update; not cam timing)
evidence: Read in full: the only compare is engine_sync_state_t.fuel_pressure_governor_demand against the 283 threshold; fault 57 = word 3 mask 0x200 = slot 162 = P1221 by the 0x5985a / obd_dtc_code_table decode; RAM dump byte 0x409aa0 = 0 so it returns at once.

plate_comment: Runs the three rail pressure governor monitors in order: cm848_checkFuelPressureGovernorDemandAtGovernedSpeed (disabled here), cm848_checkFuelPressureWithoutInjection and cm848_monitorFuelMeteringFeedbackAgainstGovernorDemand. Called from cm848_periodicTaskGroup28_calibration10. (was cm848_calibration_group28_load)
evidence: Body is exactly those three calls; no calibration is loaded.

plate_comment: Start-up initialization of the three rail pressure governor monitors: sets their 13 lookup interpolation state words 0x3fd0ea-0x3fd102 (first argument of lookupTableInterpolation) to 2. Called once from cm848_applicationMain. (was cm848_initialization_group28_state)
evidence: Body stores 2 to 13 consecutive words; a scan of the C shows 9 of them referenced only by checks A / B and the feedback monitor (the others are reached by offset from those bases), none by any other function.

plate_comment: Rail pressure tracking monitor, enabled by protection_feature_flags bit 0x4000: each pass it integrates (fuel_pressure_setpoint - fuel_pressure_feedback_previous) / ROM divisor 1 into fuel_pressure_shortfall_accumulator and, negated, fuel_pressure_excess_accumulator (both clamped at 0); above the ROM limits 245902 / 204918 it sets fault 408 / 409 (both P0148) and monitor state 3, and after a window of 6000 passes with both below the limits it clears them (state 2). It runs only with no related fault and within the coolant, fuel temperature and target_rpm (at least 600 rpm) windows. (was hpcr_camTimingMonitor; not cam timing)
evidence: Read in full: fuel_pressure_feedback_previous is the previous filtered rail pressure (CSV comment), faults 408 / 409 decode to slot 91 = P0148; ROM dwords at 0x6440e / 0x64412 = 245902 / 204918, window 0x64416 = 6000, divisor 0x64420 = 1; nothing in it touches cam timing.

plate_comment: Start-up reset of the rail pressure tracking monitor: monitor state 0, accumulators and pass count zeroed, monitor inactive; when protection_feature_flags bit 0x4000 is clear it also marks the monitor complete (clears bit 7 of fault_pending_flags, sets bit 7 of diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits). Called once from cm848_applicationMain. (was hpcr_camTimingReset)
evidence: Read in full (18 lines); same variables as the monitor.

plate_comment: Zeroes the shortfall and excess accumulators and the pass count of the rail pressure tracking monitor (0x40b9d8, 0x40b9dc, 0x3fd1e4). Called by cm848_monitorFuelPressureTrackingError and cm848_resetFuelPressureTrackingErrorMonitor. (was engine_protection_counters_reset)
evidence: xref_addr.py: the only stores to 0x40b9d8 / 0x40b9dc / 0x3fd1e4 outside the monitor are the three in this function (0x531d18 / 0x531d20 / 0x531d2c); its 3 callers are the monitor (twice) and its reset.

plate_comment: One-sided sibling of cm848_monitorFuelPressureTrackingError, enabled by protection_feature_flags bit 0x8000: it integrates (fuel_pressure_setpoint - fuel_pressure_feedback_previous) / DAT_00409fdc into fuel_pressure_setpoint_not_reached_accumulator, which is clamped at 0 and zeroed whenever fuel_pressure_sensor has reached the setpoint; above DAT_00409fce (18443) it sets fault 352 (no OBD slot) and monitor state 3, and the window ends after 300 passes (state 2). It runs only with no rail pressure or fuel metering fault, wide coolant and fuel temperature windows and target_rpm of at least 600 rpm. (was hpcr_injectSystemDiagnostic)
evidence: Read in full (86 lines): same structure as hpcr_camTimingMonitor, the accumulator is reset by "setpoint <= fuel_pressure_sensor"; fault 352 = word 22 bit 0 = slot 170 (no OBD code) and is one of the five faults that cm848_protectionInputValidator turns into reaction bits; nothing in it is an injection diagnostic.

plate_comment: Zeroes the accumulator and the pass count of the rail pressure setpoint-not-reached monitor (0x40ba62, 0x3fd266). Called by cm848_monitorFuelPressureSetpointNotReached and by cm848_initTimerInterrupts. (was engine_cssc_counters_reset)
evidence: Read in full: two stores; callers are hpcr_injectSystemDiagnostic (2 calls) and cm848_initTimerInterrupts.

plate_comment: Run each phase group B pass before cm848_diagnoseFuelPressureGovernor: counts the passes for which fuel_pressure_diagnostic_flags has differed from fuel_pressure_diagnostic_snapshot (set / clear debounce counters), and checks the fuel metering feedback circuit: it reads the feedback (QADC slot 63 or its forced reading) through the linearization table into fuel_metering_feedback_input and, after 200 passes with the feedback above the high threshold and the command below its limit (fault 265, code 1) or below the low threshold and the command above its limit (fault 264, code 2), sets the fault bit; both circuit checks are inactive in this calibration. (was cm848_updateEngineDiagnosticCounters)
evidence: Read in full; the RAM dump has the high threshold 4092, low threshold 0, command limits 0 / 0, debounce 200, so neither circuit check can trigger; slot 63 = 0x40bc80 + 2 x 63 = 0x40bcfe (forced reading, override bit 15 of the word at +78 of diagnostic_service_dispatch_table).

plate_comment: Start-up initialization of the rail pressure diagnostics: clears fuel_pressure_diagnostic_snapshot / _flags, fuel_metering_feedback_input, the too-high pending flag, count and recovery count, the two debounce counters and the two feedback circuit counters, and sets the eight lookup interpolation state words 0x3fb6cc and 0x3fb6ce-0x3fb6da to 2. Called once from cm848_applicationMain. (was cm848_initEngineDiagnosticData)
evidence: Read in full (29 lines): it clears the rail pressure diagnostic state (flags, snapshot, pending flag, counters, feedback input) and sets the interpolation state words; the snapshot and the feedback input are shared with other readers, the interpolation words and counters are not.

plate_comment: Builds fault_reaction_request_bits from the registered faults 317, 290, 324, 408 and 352 (each ORs in its own fault_NNN_reaction_request_mask; bit 3 of the previous value is kept) and requests logical output 54 while bit 3 is set. Runs before cm848_applyFuelLimitsForFuelPressureFaults in cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection3. (was cm848_protectionInputValidator)
evidence: Read in full; 317 / 290 / 324 are set by cm848_diagnoseFuelPressureGovernor, 408 by the tracking monitor, 352 by the setpoint-not-reached monitor; reaction bits are consumed by the fuel limit function, the setpoint calculator (bit 2) and the limp home flag.

plate_comment: Sets the fuel limit governor_fuel_limit_source and the second limit torque_fuel_minimum_working (an input of cm848_selectTorqueLimit, default 30000) for the rail pressure faults: P0193 / P0192 (304 / 305) use the sensor fault limits, fault 264 and P0251 (333) cap them at the fuel metering fault limits, fault reaction bits 0 / 1 cap them at the reaction limits and P0088 (303) at the too-high limits; with none of these the limit is 0x1700 (the maximum). It adds fuel_demand_offset_correction when protection_feature_flags bit 3 is set and requests logical output 54 while a too-high bit of fuel_pressure_diagnostic_snapshot is set and the enable word is non-zero. (was cm848_protectionSensorFaultHandler)
evidence: Read in full; fault numbers decoded with the ROM slot table (304 = P0193, 305 = P0192, 333 = P0251, 303 = P0088, 264 = no slot); limit values from the RAM dump (883 / 20000 / 5888 / 30400); torque_fuel_minimum_working is compared with torque_limit_arb_t.fuel_minimum in cm848_selectTorqueLimit (source 7) and starts at torque_limit_fuel_minimum = 30000, so its unit is not that of the 0x1700 fuel limit.

plate_comment: Sets fuel_pressure_limp_home_active_flag while any trigger enabled by fuel_pressure_limp_home_trigger_enable_mask is present: bit 0 / 1 = registered faults 264 / 265, bit 2 = fault 333 (P0251), bit 3 / 4 = faults 304 / 305 (P0193 / P0192), bit 5 / 6 = fault reaction request bits 0 / 1, bit 7 = fault 303 (P0088); the mask is 156 here (bits 2, 3, 4 and 7). Called each phase group B pass. (was cm848_checkProtectionFaultConditions)
evidence: Read in full (28 lines); bit-to-fault pairing taken from the masks in the code, mask value 0x9c from the RAM dump.

plate_comment: Decodes one injector row (param_2 = 1 to cylinder_event_count_max) of the 24-bit diagnostic word param_1 read by cm848_readInjectorDiagnosticWord: the row's 2-bit code sets that injector's bit in injector_diagnostic_bits_b / _a / _c for codes 0 / 1 / 2 and clears it in all four bytes for code 3, and a separate flag bit sets (when 0) or clears the injector's bit in injector_diagnostic_bits_d. Masks come from the tables at 0x57d2e and 0x57d76. (was cm848_updateProtectionBitFlags)
evidence: Read in full; the per-row fault tables at 0x57d76 decode (ROM slot table) to P0201-P0206 for class a and P2146 / P2149 (injector group supply voltage) for classes b / c, so the rows are injectors.

plate_comment: Debounces one class of injector diagnostic bits (param_1): a counter at param_2 counts up while any bit is set and down while none is set (unless param_5 blocks healing); for each injector row it sets the fault bit given by the row's entry at offset param_4 of the table at 0x57d76 when the counter is above the limit param_3 and the row's bit is set, and clears it when the counter is 0 and the bit is clear. (was cm848_protectionFaultEvaluator)
evidence: Read in full; called four times by cm848_evaluateInjectorDiagnostics with offsets 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 for classes a / c / b / d (a text search finds no other reference than its definition and these four calls).

plate_comment: Injector diagnostics, called from the TPU-A channel 10 cylinder event handler once per full cycle: when MIOS MDASM30 status bit 15 is set and protection_config_flags bit 0x40 and supervisor_register_36_bit_1_low_held_flag are clear it reads the diagnostic word with cm848_readInjectorDiagnosticWord, updates the four injector diagnostic bit bytes for each injector with cm848_updateInjectorDiagnosticBits and debounces each class with cm848_evaluateInjectorDiagnosticFault. (was mpc555_evaluateProtectionSyncFaults)
evidence: Read in full; its fault outputs are the injector circuit faults P0201-P0206 and P2146 / P2149 plus six faults without OBD slot; the old plate of the channel 10 handler names it as the wrap-around call.

plate_comment: Reads a 24-bit diagnostic word serially, most significant bit first: drives output line 0x2d low, then 24 times samples discrete input line 0x30 and pulses output line 0x2c high and low with software delay loops, releases line 0x2d and returns the word shifted left by 8. Its bit fields become the per-injector diagnostic bits in cm848_updateInjectorDiagnosticBits. (was cm848_getProtectionSyncState)
evidence: Read in full (51 lines); the "injector" part is inferred from its only consumer chain (see cm848_updateInjectorDiagnosticBits), the serial protocol itself is read directly.

Read in full (162 lines). It is neither protection nor a correction: with the engine warm, no governor fuel active and the rail pressure within 82 counts of fuel_pressure_setpoint it ramps a weighted average of fuel_demand_computed (fuel_correction_ramp_demand) and compares it with a table target (fuel_correction_timing_table 8 / 249 / 311 / 342 / 371 = 0.5 / 16.9 / 21.1 / 23.2 / 25.2 mm3, chosen by the A/C clutch request, alternator duty and automatic transmission in gear - quantities, not timing), then sets (demand not below the target, state 3) or clears (state 2) fault bit 7 = P0191. I could not settle the name: P0191 is the rail pressure sensor range / performance code, but whether this is an idle fuel demand rationality test (the governor output and vehicle speed gates did not read as plain idle) needs the callers of fuel_correction_ramp_state. Candidate if accepted: cm848_checkFuelPressureSensorPerformance.

text: Fault decode (checked against the ROM image): the slot table at 0x5985a holds 16-bit slot numbers (one word per fault bit n), obd_dtc_code_table (0x5b57c) holds the code word per slot. Fault 57 = slot 162 = P1221, 58 = 163 = P1222, 60 = 164 = P1223, 59 = slot 158 (code word 0000); faults 69 / 70 / 71 (word 4 bits 5 / 6 / 7) decode to the same three codes but no direct writer of masks 0x20 / 0x40 / 0x80 of fault_detected_bits_64_to_79 exists in the decompiled C. 303 = P0088, 304 = P0193, 305 = P0192, 333 = P0251, 408 / 409 = slot 91 = P0148 (the SAE fuel delivery error code, consistent with a rail pressure tracking monitor); faults 264, 265, 290, 315, 316, 317, 323, 324 and 352 have slot 170 (no OBD code). What the code shows for the three codes: P1221 = governor demand above 283 at governed speed (monitor disabled here), P1222 = demand above the pressure-based plausibility limit with no fuel injected (check A), P1223 = fuel metering feedback below the minimum expected for the demand; their official titles are not established from the code.

Comment fix for fault_reaction_request_bits (0x40b8a0): bit 2 caps fuel_pressure_setpoint at fuel_pressure_setpoint_fault_reaction_cap (4095 = no cap here), not cam_timing_measured; bits 0 / 1 cap governor_fuel_limit_source / torque_fuel_minimum_working (cm848_applyFuelLimitsForFuelPressureFaults), bit 3 requests logical output 54. In this calibration only fault 352 has a reaction mask (5 = bits 0 and 2) and its caps (5888 and 4095) are inactive, so the reaction path has no effect.

Calibration state of this ECM (RAM dump): the governed speed monitor is off (0x409aa0 = 0), check B is off, both feedback circuit checks cannot trigger (high threshold 4092 with command limit 0, low threshold 0), injector class d cannot set faults (debounce limit 65535), and engine_sync_enable_mask = 156 enables only faults 333 / 304 / 305 / 303 as limp home triggers.

Injector diagnostic family (resolves the wave 1 uncertain row 0x0040b8cc): cm848_readInjectorDiagnosticWord clocks in 24 bits, cm848_updateInjectorDiagnosticBits turns them into four per-injector bit bytes at 0x40b8cc-0x40b8cf, and cm848_evaluateInjectorDiagnosticFault debounces them into fault bits listed in the table at 0x57d76 (rows of 10 bytes: mask, class a, c, b, d fault): a = P0201-P0206, b / c = P2146 (injectors 1, 3, 5 group) / P2149 (2, 4, 6 group), d = faults 270 / 273 / 276 / 279 / 282 / 285 with no OBD slot. The monitors' "no related fault" gate is the four bytes being zero. The class debounce counters are the words 0x3fb6fc (a), 0x3fb6fe (c), 0x3fb700 (b), 0x3fb702 (d), reached only through the pointer argument, so xref cannot confirm them; suggested injector_diagnostic_bits_a_debounce_count and so on.

cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor (reads fuel_pressure_setpoint at 0xf75c): name kept, not verified in full (565 lines). Its rows cam_timing_correction_high_cal (0x3ff6a2 = 4), cam_timing_correction_low_cal (0x3ff6a4 = 2), cam_timing_correction_high_b_cal (0x3ff6a6 = 44) and cam_timing_correction_low_b_cal (0x3ff6a8 = 29) are not cam timing: they are a per-pass step by which fuel_demand_integrator_max is lowered and an offset subtracted from fuel_demand_base_offset to form its ceiling, the high pair chosen while (fuel_pressure_setpoint - fuel_pressure_feedback_filtered) is above fuel_pressure_error_threshold (0xfecd = -307, signed), the low pair otherwise. They lie at 0x3ff6xx, outside the EEPROM range, so the _cal suffix is wrong. Not renamed: the integrator role needs a pass over the governor.

hpcr_setFaultActiveStatus (0x1df64, reads fuel_pressure_setpoint at 0x1e098 / 0x1e1ac): the name fits (it sets a fault active and captures the freeze frame). Its capture also shows more wrong fault_entry_t field names, all direct assignments: torque_limit = main_injection_timing, load_throttle = fuel_demand_computed, pressure_adj = governor_mode_code (byte), timing_snapshot (dword) = key_on_hour_meter, sensor_scale_1 / sensor_scale_2 = diagnostic_fault_flags_a / _b.

Support relations: cm848_initTimerInterrupts (0x5371f4) also clears fault 352 and initializes the setpoint-not-reached monitor variables (hpcr_cam_diag_active_flag, cssc_injection_diag_state), so it is the sibling of cm848_resetFuelPressureTrackingErrorMonitor for that monitor; its name was not checked. The engine speed gate of both tracking monitors reads engine_rpm_state_t.target_rpm (>= 4800 counts = 600 rpm), not current_rpm.

Type notes: 0x409530 fuel_pressure_too_high_count_limit is typed word but xref_addr.py reports a byte read (value 150): it should be a byte. 0x409a6d fuel_pressure_setpoint_override_value is read as a word at an odd address (mode byte at 0x409a6c, value word at 0x409a6d), which is how the ROM block is packed. The 16 + 13 interpolation state words (0x3fd0ca-0x3fd0e8 for the setpoint calculator, 0x3fd0ea-0x3fd102 for the monitors) would be better as two arrays (word[16] and word[13]); the 7 + 1 words at 0x3fb6cc-0x3fb6da likewise.

protection_fuel_demand_* family: only 0x40b52c / 0x40b52e / 0x40b530 / 0x3fcea8 (already renamed) belong to the limiter; the limiter constants 0x408980 / 0x408982 / 0x408984 are in the new_global rows. fuel_demand_load_axis (0x40a4ea) is the ramp start but is also read elsewhere, so it stays. protection_config_flags_b (0x3fd5a8, bit 1 enables the limiter) is in the EEPROM mirror and would need _cal and a subject once its other bits are known.

Spelled initialize (not the repo usual init) in cm848_initializeFuelPressureSetpointState / cm848_initializeFuelPressureGovernorMonitorState / cm848_initializeFuelPressureDiagnosticState to follow the no-abbreviation rule; rename them to init if the repo convention wins.
